item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian forces continue drone and missile strikes on Ukrainian civilian sites, including an Oryol electronics plant and Moscow-area airports, while Ukrainian forces retaliate with strikes on the same airports, a Tolyatti factory and a Krasnodar Krai airfield. In occupied Oleshky, a local cease-fire negotiated by Melania Trump has reduced fighting, and a separate truce was agreed for another town. Ukraine reports that Starlink speed restrictions have been lifted, restoring stable connectivity for its military. A secretive Ukrainian deep-strike unit is expanding its campaign, and the conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
Ethiopian federal forces have installed a caretaker administration in Tigray and are advancing toward the Eritrean border, while a pro-government militia says it seized the regional airport and reports Eritrean forces suffered losses there. The United States, through Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate, and Mekelle mayor Shishay Amare announced elections within six months to resolve Western Tigray through constitutional processes. A drone strike in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73 people. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Somalia: the situation
item.description:
Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict, and a UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, including a pregnant teenager. The US and UAE also carried out airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia. 2,284 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

The Supreme Court halted the appeal of a former minister sentenced for embezzlement, and a Cameroonian scholar has called for new peace talks with Anglophone separatists. item.title: Eastern DR Congo: the situation
item.description:
Ebola has reached an eighth province in eastern DRC, prompting alerts in Lubumbashi and border closures by Kenya and Uganda after 12 truck drivers were killed. The ADF continues attacks in Ituri while the FRN operates near Lubumbashi, and both UPDF and FARDC are conducting joint operations against ADF commanders in the region. A mercenary force suffered combat casualties in the Congo, and rebel-linked violence has led to civilian deaths. The conflict produced 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
